features: Note : To ensure proper assembly, please follow all steps provided in the installation manual (provided in pdf below)
description: The perfect functional display piece, this book match styled buffet is the piece you didn’t know you needed. Comprised of mixed materials of silver hardware and durable laminate doors for a two-toned finish with adjustable rubber feet, the possibilities are endless. Whether placed in your unique kitchen as a traditional buffet or your living room for additional storage, this piece will feel both new and familiar with its midcentury modern appeal.
